scripts.title_zh: 修好一块普通海图压板

paragraphs.en: The corner kept lifting whenever I turned the chart. Hold it flat for a moment, please.
paragraphs.zh: 我一转海图，角就翘起来。请先帮我压平。

paragraphs.en: The weight is heavy enough. Is the board bent?
paragraphs.zh: 压块够重。是板子弯了吗？

paragraphs.en: Only at this end. I put a thin strip underneath instead of forcing the whole board down.
paragraphs.zh: 只有这一端。我在下面垫了窄条，没有硬把整块板子压下去。

paragraphs.en: Now it stays still. Shall I move the strip into the middle?
paragraphs.zh: 现在稳了。要把窄条移到中间吗？

paragraphs.en: Leave it here. In the middle it would lift the good side. Sometimes a small repair has a very particular address.
paragraphs.zh: 留在这儿。放在中间反而会把平的那边顶起来。有时小修补也得放准地方。

paragraphs.en: I will mark the underside, then. Someone can find it next time the board comes apart.
paragraphs.zh: 那我在底面做个记号，下次拆开还能找到。

paragraphs.en: Good. And we can finally look at the chart without having to argue with its corners.
paragraphs.zh: 好。总算能看海图，不必先和它的角较劲。

scripts.title_zh: 听过家人回信后如何折起信纸

paragraphs.en: The fold is beginning to tear. I keep opening the same edge first.
paragraphs.zh: 折痕快破了。我每次都先从同一边打开。

paragraphs.en: Would a new envelope help? You can keep the writing covered while we try it.
paragraphs.zh: 换个封套会有用吗？试的时候可以把字盖住。

paragraphs.en: Yes. You have heard the part I chose to share. The rest can stay inside.
paragraphs.zh: 会。你听过我愿意分享的那部分，其余的留在里面就好。

paragraphs.en: Then I will measure the folded paper, not spread the letter out.
paragraphs.zh: 那我量折好后的纸，不把信摊开。

paragraphs.en: Give it a little room at the top. I do not want to squeeze it into a neat shape and damage it.
paragraphs.zh: 上面留一点余量。我不想为了折得整齐把它挤坏。

paragraphs.en: This flap closes without another crease. Shall I leave the envelope blank?
paragraphs.zh: 这个封口不用再折一道。封套留空白吗？

paragraphs.en: Please. I know what is in it. It does not need to tell everyone who passes the table.
paragraphs.zh: 留空白吧。我知道里面是什么，不必告诉每个经过桌边的人。

scripts.title_zh: 从船头判断风向，不提供关卡答案

paragraphs.en: Watch the loose end of that ribbon. It tells us more than the flag pressed against the mast.
paragraphs.zh: 看那段松开的带子。它比贴在桅杆上的旗更好判断。

paragraphs.en: It points towards the stern. Does that settle the wind direction?
paragraphs.zh: 它指向船尾。这就能确定风向了吗？

paragraphs.en: For this little patch of deck. The cabin can bend the air around us. Take another reading where it is clear.
paragraphs.zh: 只能说明甲板这一小块。船舱会让气流绕过来。再到开阔处看一次。

paragraphs.en: The second ribbon moves at a slightly different angle.
paragraphs.zh: 第二条的角度稍有不同。

paragraphs.en: Then keep both observations. I would rather write a small uncertainty than draw one very confident arrow.
paragraphs.zh: 那就都记下。我宁愿留一点不确定，也不想画一根过分肯定的箭头。

paragraphs.en: And for sailing we still need the current chart and the watch report.
paragraphs.zh: 真正开船时还得看当前海图和值守记录。

paragraphs.en: Exactly. Today we are learning to look, while the ship is safely tied up.
paragraphs.zh: 是的。今天船还好好系在泊位上，我们只是练习观察。

scripts.title_zh: 把一件旧工具放回自己修好的框里

paragraphs.en: That narrow space is for the old spanner. I made it fit the handle instead of the other way round.
paragraphs.zh: 那个窄格放旧扳手。我让格子适合柄，没有反过来磨柄。

paragraphs.en: It is a rather plain frame for something you spent so long repairing.
paragraphs.zh: 你修了这么久，框倒挺朴素。

paragraphs.en: It is supposed to make the tools easy to find. If people have to admire it first, I have made a bad cupboard.
paragraphs.zh: 它是让人方便找工具的。要是得先欣赏一番，那我柜子做坏了。

paragraphs.en: There is still an empty space. Are you saving it for a new tool?
paragraphs.zh: 还空了一格。留给新工具吗？

paragraphs.en: For the tool that is being used. An empty place can remind me to ask where it went.
paragraphs.zh: 留给正在用的工具。空位能提醒我问问它去了哪里。

paragraphs.en: I will put the spanner back with its handle facing out.
paragraphs.zh: 那我把扳手放回去，柄朝外。

paragraphs.en: Thank you. That is the whole ceremony. No polishing required.
paragraphs.zh: 谢谢。仪式到这里就完了，不用抛光。

scripts.title_zh: 在公共饭桌承认这次不是只换一个螺钉

paragraphs.en: You said the stool needed one screw. Why are there three pieces beside your plate?
paragraphs.zh: 你说凳子只缺一颗螺钉，怎么盘子旁边有三块零件？

paragraphs.en: Because I said that before I looked underneath. The joint was split, and the brace was loose.
paragraphs.zh: 因为那是我看底面之前说的。接头裂了，撑条也松了。

paragraphs.en: So the first estimate was wrong.
paragraphs.zh: 所以最初估计错了。

paragraphs.en: Yes. I should have called it an estimate instead of promising a quick job. Put your bowl on the bench for now.
paragraphs.zh: 是。我该说是估计，而不是答应马上修好。碗暂时放长凳上吧。

paragraphs.en: Can the repair wait until we finish eating?
paragraphs.zh: 可以吃完饭再修吗？

paragraphs.en: It can, if nobody sits on it. I will leave a note where someone would actually see it.
paragraphs.zh: 可以，只要没人坐。我把便条放到人真能看到的地方。

paragraphs.en: Then put the pieces away. Your soup will not wait as patiently as the stool.
paragraphs.zh: 那先收好零件。汤可没凳子这么有耐心。

scripts.title_zh: 修一只不含主线钥匙的杯把

paragraphs.en: The cup itself is sound. The handle came away because this old join was doing all the work.
paragraphs.zh: 杯身没问题。旧接头独自吃力，杯把才掉下来。

paragraphs.en: Can we just glue the handle back on?
paragraphs.zh: 把杯把粘回去就行吗？

paragraphs.en: We can mend it, but I would test it with cold water before trusting it with hot tea. Hold the cup, not the handle.
paragraphs.zh: 能修，但用它喝热茶之前，我会先装冷水试。拿杯身，别拿把。

paragraphs.en: This old crack still shows.
paragraphs.zh: 旧裂痕还看得见。

paragraphs.en: That is all right. A visible repair reminds us to treat it carefully. I do not need to make the cup look new.
paragraphs.zh: 没关系。看得见的修补提醒我们小心用，不必把杯子装成新的。

paragraphs.en: I will leave it upside down here to dry.
paragraphs.zh: 我把它倒扣在这里晾干。

paragraphs.en: And I will write which cup it is. Otherwise we will have a very careful warning attached to the wrong cup.
paragraphs.zh: 我记清是哪只杯。不然一张十分谨慎的警告，会贴到另一只杯上。

scripts.title_zh: 给公共书架留下可改写的书目卡

paragraphs.en: The book is on the lower shelf, but its card sends everyone upstairs.
paragraphs.zh: 书在下层，书目卡却把人指到楼上。

paragraphs.en: Shall I throw the card away and write a clean one?
paragraphs.zh: 把卡扔掉，写张干净的吗？

paragraphs.en: Turn it over. We can date the correction and leave the old location visible. It explains why someone might still look there.
paragraphs.zh: 翻过来吧。我们写上更正日期，旧位置也留着。这样还去那里找的人有个解释。

paragraphs.en: There is room for another change underneath.
paragraphs.zh: 下面还能再记一次变动。

paragraphs.en: Good. Public shelves move about. A card that allows correction is more useful than a very solemn permanent label.
paragraphs.zh: 好。公共书架常换位置。能更正的卡，比一本正经的永久标签更有用。

paragraphs.en: Lower shelf, left side. I have also left a blank line for whoever moves it next.
paragraphs.zh: 下层左侧。我也给下一个移书的人留了空行。

paragraphs.en: Now let us put the card where readers start looking, instead of keeping it in my notebook.
paragraphs.zh: 现在把卡放到读者开始找书的地方，别夹在我的笔记里。

scripts.title_zh: 承认自己也喜欢没有注释的故事

paragraphs.en: You have not written a single note in that book.
paragraphs.zh: 这本书你一条注释也没写。

paragraphs.en: I wanted to find out what happened to the traveller before I started asking about the road.
paragraphs.zh: 我想先知道旅人后来怎样，再追问路是怎么回事。

paragraphs.en: Was the ending convincing?
paragraphs.zh: 结尾可信吗？

paragraphs.en: For a story, yes. I liked the part where she went home and found her neighbour had watered the plants.
paragraphs.zh: 作为故事，我觉得可信。我喜欢她回家后发现邻居一直替她浇花的那段。

paragraphs.en: No missing document, no final explanation?
paragraphs.zh: 没有缺失的文件，也没有最后的说明？

paragraphs.en: Just a living plant. I do enjoy a book that lets a small kindness remain small.
paragraphs.zh: 只有一盆活着的植物。我也喜欢一本书，让小小的善意就保持那么小。

paragraphs.en: Then I will borrow it when you have finished. I promise not to demand footnotes from the flowers.
paragraphs.zh: 你读完借我吧。我保证不向花索要脚注。

scripts.title_zh: 把旧档案封套改成不暴露姓名的标签

paragraphs.en: This used envelope has a name written across the front. The back is still blank.
paragraphs.zh: 这个旧封套正面写着姓名，背面还空着。

paragraphs.en: Could we cover the name and use it for public shelf cards?
paragraphs.zh: 盖住名字，拿来放公共书目卡吗？

paragraphs.en: Only after the original contents have gone back to their proper custodian. An empty cover is not permission to move its papers.
paragraphs.zh: 得先把原来的文件交回合适的保管人。封套空了，也不等于允许搬走里面的纸。

paragraphs.en: This one is already marked as empty stock. I can turn it inside out.
paragraphs.zh: 这一只已标为废空套。我可以把它翻面。

paragraphs.en: Then label the new use and the date. Do not put the old name on the new label just because it fits.
paragraphs.zh: 那就写新用途和日期。别因为旧名字放得下，就抄到新标签上。

paragraphs.en: Public book cards, spare sleeves. That should be enough.
paragraphs.zh: 公共书目卡，备用封套。这样就够了。

paragraphs.en: Enough, and much easier to find. A label should help with the task in front of us.
paragraphs.zh: 够了，也好找。标签应该帮助我们完成眼前的事。

scripts.title_zh: 解释地图边缘的一条日常小路

paragraphs.en: That little line ends at the edge because the map ends there. The path does not.
paragraphs.zh: 小线到边缘就断了，是地图到头了，路没有。

paragraphs.en: Do people use it often?
paragraphs.zh: 常有人走吗？

paragraphs.en: On ordinary dry mornings. It leads from the washing place to the houses above it. A loaded cart takes another way.
paragraphs.zh: 普通的晴天早晨有人走。从洗衣处上到房子那边。载重车走另一条。

paragraphs.en: So adding one line would still leave out quite a lot.
paragraphs.zh: 看来只补一根线，还会漏掉不少东西。

paragraphs.en: Write who uses it and when, then leave space for a local correction. I have walked it, but that does not make me every neighbour.
paragraphs.zh: 写上谁用、何时用，再留地方让当地人更正。我走过，但我不代表每个邻居。

paragraphs.en: I will mark it as an ordinary footpath, not a verified route for our ship.
paragraphs.zh: 我标成日常步道，不当作我们船的已核航线。

paragraphs.en: Good. People can recognise their morning walk without being promised something much larger.
paragraphs.zh: 好。人们能认出自己的晨路，不必顺带收到更大的承诺。

scripts.title_zh: 为陌生船员留一份天气留言

paragraphs.en: The next watch may not know which corner stays wet after a shower.
paragraphs.zh: 下一班可能不知道下过雨后哪个角落一直湿。

paragraphs.en: I can leave them a weather warning.
paragraphs.zh: 我可以留个天气警告。

paragraphs.en: Leave an observation with it. Say when we looked and where. A warning without those things is hard to use tomorrow.
paragraphs.zh: 也写上观察。说明何时看、看哪里。没这些，警告到了明天就很难用。

paragraphs.en: After the last shower, beside the forward rail. Check the surface before carrying anything across.
paragraphs.zh: 上一阵雨后，前栏杆旁。搬东西经过前先检查地面。

paragraphs.en: That is useful. Keep the forecast separate; we are not giving the next sailor a new weather instrument.
paragraphs.zh: 有用。预报另写；我们又没给下一个船员一台新天气仪。

paragraphs.en: And I will attach it at eye level, not underneath the bucket.
paragraphs.zh: 我把它挂到看得到的高度，不压在桶底下。

paragraphs.en: Thank you. Whoever comes next should not need to know our habits to find the note.
paragraphs.zh: 谢谢。后来的人不该先熟悉我们的习惯，才能找到便条。

scripts.title_zh: 讨论谁把甲板绳结打得太紧

paragraphs.en: This knot is tight enough to hold the whole harbour. Who tied it?
paragraphs.zh: 这绳结紧得像能系住整个港口。谁打的？

paragraphs.en: I do not know. Let us ask before we give someone the credit or the blame.
paragraphs.zh: 我不知道。给人记功或怪人之前，先问问。

paragraphs.en: Can I cut the rope?
paragraphs.zh: 我能把绳子剪开吗？

paragraphs.en: This spare coil carries no load, so we can work on the knot. Leave the actual mooring lines alone.
paragraphs.zh: 这是不吃力的备用绳圈，可以慢慢解。实际系泊绳别碰。

paragraphs.en: There. The end comes through if I loosen this turn first.
paragraphs.zh: 好了。先松这一圈，绳头就能穿过去。

paragraphs.en: Now coil it with a little space. The next person may have cold hands and much less patience than us.
paragraphs.zh: 现在卷松一点。下个人可能手冷，耐心也没我们多。

paragraphs.en: We have solved the knot, at least. The mystery of its maker can wait.
paragraphs.zh: 至少结解开了。打结的人是谁，可以以后再说。

scripts.title_zh: 谁把修好的椅子又拆开了

paragraphs.en: I thought you fixed that chair yesterday.
paragraphs.zh: 我以为你昨天把椅子修好了。

paragraphs.en: I did. Today I am making it quieter.
paragraphs.zh: 修好了。今天我让它安静点。

paragraphs.en: It was perfectly quiet while nobody was sitting on it.
paragraphs.zh: 没人坐的时候，它可安静了。

paragraphs.en: That was not the condition I was testing.
paragraphs.zh: 那不是我要测试的条件。

paragraphs.en: Then write a warning: safe for people who never sit down.
paragraphs.zh: 那就写个警告：适合永远不坐下的人安全使用。

paragraphs.en: Or you could hold this part while I tighten the other side.
paragraphs.zh: 或者你拿住这一块，我拧紧另一边。

paragraphs.en: All right. But when it is finished, we are allowed to use it. You cannot keep every repaired object as an unfinished experiment.
paragraphs.zh: 好。但修完以后得让我们用。你不能把每件修好的东西都留成未完的实验。

paragraphs.en: Agreed. Sit down after I put the last screw back.
paragraphs.zh: 同意。等我把最后一颗螺钉装回去，你再坐。

scripts.title_zh: 坏掉的指南针并不让每条航线都变假

paragraphs.en: This compass needle keeps sticking against the glass. I would not use it to set a course.
paragraphs.zh: 这指南针的针一直蹭着玻璃，我不会拿它定航向。

paragraphs.en: The case is bent. I can inspect it without asking you to trust the reading.
paragraphs.zh: 壳子弯了。我可以检查，不用让你先信它的读数。

paragraphs.en: Good. I have heard people say that if one compass is bad, every route drawn with a compass must be false.
paragraphs.zh: 好。有人说一个指南针坏了，所有用指南针画的航线就都是假的。

paragraphs.en: That skips several questions. Which instrument, which day, and what else did the navigator check?
paragraphs.zh: 这跳过了好几个问题。哪台仪器、哪一天，领航的人还核对过什么？

paragraphs.en: We will mark this one as out of use. Existing routes keep their own sources and need their own checks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们给这一台标停用。已有航线保留自己的来源，也要各自核查。

paragraphs.en: And I will put the cover beside it, rather than making it look ready on the shelf.
paragraphs.zh: 我把拆下的盖子放旁边，免得摆在架上像能用了。

paragraphs.en: That is a warning I can understand from the doorway.
paragraphs.zh: 这个警告，我在门口就能看懂。

scripts.title_zh: 海图上的手写备注应放在哪里

paragraphs.en: I need this note near the reef, but it covers the depth figures.
paragraphs.zh: 这条备注该放礁石旁，可它挡住了水深数字。

paragraphs.en: Could you put a small reference mark here and keep the full sentence in the margin?
paragraphs.zh: 这里放个小标记，完整句子写在页边好吗？

paragraphs.en: The margin already has two versions. I do not want the newest one to look like it was always there.
paragraphs.zh: 页边已经有两版。我不想让新版看起来像一直都在。

paragraphs.en: Date it, then. Keep the earlier note readable and say which observation led to the change.
paragraphs.zh: 那写日期。旧备注留得能读，也说明什么观察让你改了它。

paragraphs.en: That takes more room than an arrow.
paragraphs.zh: 这比一根箭头占地方。

paragraphs.en: It does. We can use a separate card instead of making the chart too crowded to read.
paragraphs.zh: 是。我们用另页卡，别把海图挤得看不清。

paragraphs.en: A dated card and a small mark, then. The rocks can keep the space they need.
paragraphs.zh: 那就带日期的卡，加小标记。给礁石留够地方。

scripts.title_zh: 回信可以保留原话，不必改成公告

paragraphs.en: I want to keep the words as they came. They sound different when I turn them into a summary.
paragraphs.zh: 我想保留收到时的原话。改成摘要，听起来就不同了。

paragraphs.en: Then keep the letter in your own cover. We do not need to make a public notice out of it.
paragraphs.zh: 那就留在你自己的封套里，不用变成公共公告。

paragraphs.en: I agreed to talk about keeping it. That is as far as I want this conversation to go.
paragraphs.zh: 我同意谈怎么保存它。这次我只想谈到这里。

paragraphs.en: Understood. I will not copy a sentence or add the sender to a shared catalogue.
paragraphs.zh: 明白。我不会抄一句，也不会把寄信人记到共享书目里。

paragraphs.en: Could the outside just say that it belongs to me?
paragraphs.zh: 外面只写它是我的，可以吗？

paragraphs.en: Yes. Your own label can help you find it without inviting everyone else to read it.
paragraphs.zh: 可以。你自己的标签能让你找到它，不必邀请所有人来看。

paragraphs.en: That feels better. I can put it away without pretending it is less important to me.
paragraphs.zh: 这样好些。我能把它收起来，也不用装作它对我没那么重要。

scripts.title_zh: 海风与山口风的不同判断

paragraphs.en: At sea I can watch the surface as well as the sail. What do you watch in a narrow pass?
paragraphs.zh: 海上我能看水面，也能看帆。狭窄山口你看什么？

paragraphs.en: Dust, loose grass, and the places where the air changes after a bend. One patch can be quiet while the next is rough.
paragraphs.zh: 灰、松草，还有转弯后风变的地方。这一块安静，下一块可能很乱。

paragraphs.en: So I should not carry a reading from an open slope straight into the pass.
paragraphs.zh: 看来不能把开阔坡地的读数直接用到山口里。

paragraphs.en: Nor assume the calm spot will stay calm. I write where I stood before I write what I thought.
paragraphs.zh: 也别假定无风处一直无风。我先写站在哪里，再写我的判断。

paragraphs.en: We do the same on the deck, when the cabin interrupts the air.
paragraphs.zh: 甲板上船舱挡住气流时，我们也这样。

paragraphs.en: Then we have a useful habit in common. It still leaves us needing local measurements for a real journey.
paragraphs.zh: 那我们有个共同的好习惯。真正赶路时，还是需要当地测量。

scripts.title_zh: 路线图上没有画出的休息点

paragraphs.en: There is a sheltered bench along that ordinary footpath. People use it to sort their bags.
paragraphs.zh: 那条普通步道旁有张避风长凳，人们用来整理行李。

paragraphs.en: The map shows the path but no place to stop. Would the bench deserve a mark?
paragraphs.zh: 地图画了路，没画停歇处。长凳值得标吗？

paragraphs.en: A small one, with a date. It is useful to a tired walker, though it is not a refuge for every emergency.
paragraphs.zh: 标个小点，写日期。对疲惫行人有用，但并不是每种紧急情况的避难处。

paragraphs.en: I will leave room for someone to say the bench has moved.
paragraphs.zh: 我留地方，让人能补充长凳搬走了。

paragraphs.en: And say it is an ordinary stop. Nobody has checked it as a cargo holding point.
paragraphs.zh: 也写明是普通休息点。没人核查过它能不能停放货物。

paragraphs.en: A map can help someone rest without making another promise for the harbour office.
paragraphs.zh: 地图能帮人歇脚，不必顺手替港务办公室许诺。

paragraphs.en: That would be a pleasant sort of useful.
paragraphs.zh: 这种有用，倒让人舒服。

scripts.title_zh: 说明书旁边能不能画一只猫

paragraphs.en: Would a cat in this empty margin interfere with your filing system?
paragraphs.zh: 在这块空白画只猫，会妨碍你归档吗？

paragraphs.en: Is it a manufacturer mark, a warning, or just a cat?
paragraphs.zh: 它是制造商标志、警告，还是就是一只猫？

paragraphs.en: Just a cat. I was waiting for the glue to set.
paragraphs.zh: 就是猫。我在等胶干。

paragraphs.en: Then leave the instructions visible and mark the drawing as yours. A later reader should not have to guess its authority.
paragraphs.zh: 那别遮说明，注明是你画的。后来读的人不该猜它有没有正式含义。

paragraphs.en: Personal drawing, no technical meaning. That is a rather official sentence for a cat.
paragraphs.zh: 个人绘画，无技术含义。对一只猫来说，这句话挺正式。

paragraphs.en: You can write it smaller. We should still be able to tell the cat from the actual warning beside it.
paragraphs.zh: 可以写小一点。但还得能分清它和旁边真正的警告。

paragraphs.en: Agreed. I will give the warning the larger box.
paragraphs.zh: 好。警告的框画大一点。

scripts.title_zh: 承认错误不等于删除记录

paragraphs.en: I wrote the wrong size on this spare drawer. I could remove the whole label and start again.
paragraphs.zh: 我把备用抽屉的尺寸写错了，可以整张撕掉重写。

paragraphs.en: Has someone already used it to sort parts?
paragraphs.zh: 已经有人照它分零件了吗？

paragraphs.en: Yes. Two pieces are in the wrong place now. I have moved them back.
paragraphs.zh: 有。两块放错了，我已放回去。

paragraphs.en: Then keep a dated correction. It lets the next person understand why their earlier count disagrees.
paragraphs.zh: 那保留带日期的更正。下个人就能明白为什么先前数目对不上。

paragraphs.en: The old number is embarrassing, but crossing it out is quick enough.
paragraphs.zh: 旧数字有点丢人，不过划掉也不费事。

paragraphs.en: And the correction says what you did. It does not have to make a claim about every other drawer.
paragraphs.zh: 更正也说明你做了什么。不必顺便对每个别的抽屉下结论。

paragraphs.en: I will check this drawer once more, then leave the two dates where people can read them.
paragraphs.zh: 我再查一次这个抽屉，然后把两个日期都留在看得见的地方。

scripts.title_zh: 工具收纳与现场携带争论

paragraphs.en: If the tools face the same way, I can see which one is missing at a glance.
paragraphs.zh: 工具朝同一边放，我一眼就能看出缺哪件。

paragraphs.en: In the workshop, yes. On a narrow path I need the one I can reach without putting the bag down.
paragraphs.zh: 工坊里是。窄路上，我得拿到不用放下包就能取的那件。

paragraphs.en: Then the workshop order is not necessarily the carrying order.
paragraphs.zh: 那工坊里的顺序，未必适合携带。

paragraphs.en: Keep a list of what goes out. Let the travelling set have its own pockets. We can return it to your frame afterwards.
paragraphs.zh: 出门时列个表。随身工具用自己的袋格。回来再放你的框里。

paragraphs.en: I could label the pockets so they do not end up full of loose screws.
paragraphs.zh: 我可以给袋格贴标签，免得最后只剩一堆松螺钉。

paragraphs.en: Please leave one pocket empty. I always find something I need to carry back.
paragraphs.zh: 请留一个空格。我总会发现有东西得带回来。

paragraphs.en: An empty pocket on the list. I can live with that.
paragraphs.zh: 空格也列到表上。这我能接受。

scripts.title_zh: 别给每个紧急请求都写永久承诺

paragraphs.en: This note says you will help whenever the hinge sticks. Does whenever include every night?
paragraphs.zh: 这便条说铰链一卡住你就来帮忙。“一”包括每个夜里吗？

paragraphs.en: I meant the next maintenance visit. I have written a larger promise than I can keep.
paragraphs.zh: 我指的是下一次维修来访。我写了个自己守不住的大承诺。

paragraphs.en: Then give the visit a window and leave an alternative contact for the hours outside it.
paragraphs.zh: 那写清来访窗口，再给窗口之外留另一种联系办法。

paragraphs.en: I should ask that contact first. I cannot volunteer someone by writing their name.
paragraphs.zh: 我得先问那个人。写上姓名，不能替人答应。

paragraphs.en: Exactly. Until they agree, say the alternative is unconfirmed. The note can tell the truth while we finish the arrangement.
paragraphs.zh: 是。在对方同意前，就写备选还未确认。安排没完成，便条也可以说真话。

paragraphs.en: Next visit only, other hours pending. It sounds smaller, but someone can actually use it.
paragraphs.zh: 仅下次来访，其余时间待定。听着小了，却真能用。

scripts.title_zh: 路牌的旧名字与住民的新叫法

paragraphs.en: The old sign uses one name, and the people giving directions use another. Which should go on this card?
paragraphs.zh: 旧路牌一个名字，指路的人用另一个。卡上写哪个？

paragraphs.en: Both, with a short note about where each is used. Someone arriving with an older map still needs to find the road.
paragraphs.zh: 都写，简短说明各自用在哪里。拿旧地图来的人也得找到路。

paragraphs.en: Should we call the old name incorrect?
paragraphs.zh: 要说旧名字错了吗？

paragraphs.en: Not from this conversation alone. We have heard the current everyday name; we have not changed the public register.
paragraphs.zh: 只凭这次聊天还不能。我们听到了现在日常的叫法，还没改公共登记。

paragraphs.en: Then I will date the note and keep the two sources separate.
paragraphs.zh: 那我注明日期，把两个来源分开。

paragraphs.en: That gives people a way to ask a better question instead of losing their way while we settle the wording.
paragraphs.zh: 这样人们能问得更明白，不必等我们把措辞定完才能不迷路。

scripts.title_zh: 一条规则应该让使用者看得懂

paragraphs.en: I have read this storage rule twice. I still cannot tell where the wet boots go.
paragraphs.zh: 收纳规则读两遍了，我还是不知道湿靴子放哪里。

paragraphs.en: The sentence says equipment requiring ventilation. That is rather far from a pair of boots.
paragraphs.zh: 句子写的是“需要通风的器材”。离一双靴子有点远。

paragraphs.en: Could we write wet boots on the rack label, and keep the full rule beside it?
paragraphs.zh: 架上直接写“湿靴子”，完整规则放旁边好吗？

paragraphs.en: Yes, with a picture showing the gap below them. The shorter instruction should preserve the actual requirement.
paragraphs.zh: 好，再画出下面要留的空隙。短说明仍得保留真正的要求。

paragraphs.en: I will ask the next person to use it without hearing us explain it first.
paragraphs.zh: 我请下个人自己照它放，不先听我们解释。

paragraphs.en: That will tell us something useful. If they choose the wrong shelf, we can improve the label rather than complain about the reader.
paragraphs.zh: 这样能知道些有用的事。要是放错架，我们可以改标签，不急着怪读的人。

paragraphs.en: Then this pair of boots can be our first trial. They have waited long enough.
paragraphs.zh: 那先拿这双试。它们等得够久了。
